text:
Maya Patel: heads-up — retention team asked to surface SLO thresholds in tenant dashboards but with a per-tenant "quieting" model to reduce noise. wants to avoid pages for transient spikes. any concerns?

Samir Chen: quieting is fine but we need visibility into what got suppressed. otherwise we hide real regressions. can we show suppressed_count + a raw-events link? :thinking: 

Li Wei: agree with Samir. also need clear fallback rules (when suppression expires or if error persists -> escalate). otherwise ops will miss slow burn incidents.

Anya K: UX: less clutter on dashboard is good, but we should surface suppression reason inline (tooltip) and allow un-suppress per-tenant. quick mock: "View suppressed alerts (3) -> expands list"

Maya Patel: proposed internal API shape (brain-dump):
```yaml
alert_surface: 
  threshold: 99.5
  quieting: 
    enabled: true
    window: 5m
    min_incidents: 3
    suppression_ratio: 0.75
    notify_fallback: ["email", "oncall-page"]
  expose: ["raw_count","suppressed_count","suppression_window_end"]
```

Samir Chen: if we add expose fields, make sure prometheus/telemetry uses distinct metrics: `slo.alerts.raw_count` vs `slo.alerts.notified_count` so billing/incident math isn't ambiguous.

Jorge Ramos: operational question — who owns quieting policy per tenant? platform or tenancy team? leaning platform default + tenant opt-out flag.

Maya Patel: +1 platform default with tenant opt-out. action: I'll draft a short RFC and include API proposals + telemetry metrics.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of notify-service v2.8.1 -> success (23:14 UTC) :white_check_mark:

Li Wei: one more ask — add audit events when suppression toggles or when suppressed_count spikes (for postmortem).

Samir Chen: sounds good. also include a small console affordance to "show suppressed events" that expands the time range and links to raw traces.

Anya K: I'll make a tiny mock and attach to the RFC.

Maya Patel: great. owners: Maya (RFC + API), Anya (UX mock), Li (telemetry/metrics), Samir (alert semantics). will schedule sync next Tue. thanks all :thumbsup:
